_about: The alert's non-personal copy. No names live here. The pipeline (alert/pipeline.py) fills {SITE_URL} and {PRIVACY_URL} from settings, joins each person's opener with alert_block and privacy_line into custom_message_1 before import, and leaves {{first_name}} for GetSales to render. Draft until Alex ticks the pre-send gate. Constraints from the research on delivery, reception and personal data: note under 200 characters, one short retypeable link, the right to object in its own sentence, a job application rather than a pitch (no freelance, services, offer, book a call), AI use said plainly by Alex himself, and no promise of what the site shows tonight.
note_with_link: Hi {{first_name}}, I'm applying to work with Addvery via a 12-hour live build today. Follow along: {SITE_URL} (privacy note there). Rather not? Ignore this, I won't follow up. Alex
note_without_link: Hi {{first_name}}, I'm applying to work with Addvery via a 12-hour live build today, and you're welcome to follow along. Rather not? Ignore this, I won't follow up. Alex
alert_block: I'm applying to work with Addvery as a GTM engineer in an unusual way: a 12-hour live build today of the research and outbound systems I'd build at Addvery, recorded as it happens. You can follow along at {SITE_URL}
privacy_line: Why you're getting this, and what I keep about you: {PRIVACY_URL}. If you'd rather I stopped, reply "no" and I'll delete what I hold and not write again.
msg2_why: A word on why I'm doing it this way. My background is B2B marketing, and the work I want now is GTM engineering: building the systems that find the right accounts, research them and start the right conversations. A CV can only claim that, so I built it in the open instead. Most of the building was done by AI agents working under my direction, including the research behind my first message to you. Deciding what to build, and checking it, was my part. It's all at {SITE_URL}
msg3_close: Last note from me on this. If anything in the build is useful for Addvery, I'd value 20 minutes to walk you through it, or to hear what you'd have done differently. If not, no reply needed, and I won't follow up. Alex
